source: onsemi TIP120〜TIP122 / TIP125〜TIP127 データシート (TIP120/D Rev. 10, 2024-06)
ft: 表の |hfe| の min 4 (1 MHz) から。実物はふつうこれより速い
vaf: データシートに出力の特性が無いので、仮に 100 V としました
diode: データシートに特性が無いので、前のモデルと同じ一般的な値 (IS = 1 nA、N = 1.5、RS = 0.05 Ω) を仮に置きました
name: TIP120
description: NPN ダーリントン・パワートランジスタ 60V 5A (TO-220, ピン1=B 2=C 3=E)。マイコンから小さな電流でモーターやリレーを駆動。データシート (onsemi) の代表特性から作った等価モデル
remarks: read with `cargo run -p datasheet --example ds -- trace` on pages 5 and 6 and checked against the rendered pages; the left graphs of Figures 9 and 11 are the NPN ones

hfe: Figure 9 (VCE = 4 V), the middle of the three curves (25 C; 150 C above, -55 C below). Only the currents where the three are told apart are used; at 3 and 5 A the 150 C and 25 C curves lie on each other
vbe_on, vbe_sat, vce_sat: Figure 11 (IC/IB = 250 and VCE = 4 V): VBE(sat) is the top line, VBE the middle one, VCE(sat) the bottom one; at 1 A the two VBE lines meet (the one value is used for both)
cib, cob: Figure 8, the dashed (NPN) curves; dashes are found only at some voltages (Cob at 0.1 and 0.5 V, Cib at 0.1, 1 and 2 V)
r1, r2: the data sheet's schematic (about 8 kohm and 120 ohm). area (the driver ten times smaller), VAF and the diode are assumptions (not in the data sheet), said in the limits
